description: The two workloads apart (docs/HYPOTHESES.md, 2026-11-06): updates only (the base point's 150,000 updates and deletes a write, clustered by region, no inserts), with every update reading its old rows (updateRead row): MoR, MoR compacted every 10 writes, MoR reading every column in its locate (Spark's plan), RMoR, RMoW-external, RMoW-append and RMoR with deferred merges at two thresholds and two placements; and inserts only (the base point's 350,000 a write, sorted by event time, lateness p99 1, 5 and 20 writes): MoR, MoR compacted, RMoR and RMoW-append. Payload checks off, requests and held memory logged.
